snapshot.description: Snapshot matches git, project context and task state → fast-path VALID.
Task state phase changed → INVALID, full rebuild.
Relevant file content changed → STALE, project-level rebuild.
New relevant file appears → STALE, project-level rebuild.
Git ref moved → STALE, project-level rebuild.
Stored taskStateHash tampered → INVALID, full rebuild.
Stored relevantFilesHash tampered → STALE, project-level rebuild.
Snapshot deleted → STALE no-snapshot, full rebuild.
Snapshot is not valid JSON → safe fallback, full rebuild.
Snapshot parses but lacks hash fields → INVALID, full rebuild.
